explanation: This lemma does not duplicate Mathlib. It is a definitional unfolding, proved by `rfl`, of the library's own definition `TauCeti.DynkinType.rootLength` (defined at line 123 of RootLength.lean) at the library's own type `TauCeti.DynkinType.F4`. All of its content lives in the library's definitions. Mathlib has `RootPairing.RootPositiveForm.rootLength`, but that is a different notion (root lengths with respect to an invariant form on a root pairing). It has no per-Dynkin-type table of lengths that this lemma could restate, so I did not search Mathlib further.
